name: Realm of Myr
description:
The setting of Myr is a rich and diverse fantasy world filled with vibrant cultures, ancient civilizations, and varied landscapes, from lush forests and towering mountains to vast deserts and mysterious seas.

The world is home to humans, elves, dwarves, halflings, orcs, and more, each with their own unique societies and histories. Nations within the main continent in Myr range from wilds and townscapes of the March of Davos, to the powerful and expansionist Asterian Empire, and on to the mysterious elven realms of Evervale and the hardy dwarven kingdoms of Hammerdeep. Myr’s history is marked by the rise and fall of great empires, legendary heroes, and the influence of powerful Immortals who guide and manipulate the mortal world.
